content: Cycle 2 (5b.3 + 5b.4) implemented — commit 0edabe5, 201 tests passing (frontend-only change; no backend edits). §5b.3: health strip (database/ollama/worker LEDs from public /health on the 5s poll, grey=worker-disabled vs red=down, fetched outside the api() helper so a degraded component is data not a poll failure); client-side filter bar (project/severity/title-search/needs-input quick filter/clear; column counts switch from global /queue counts to filtered-row counts while active); Terminal column collapsed-to-count by default (persisted in localStorage), expandable, capped at 15 cards with show-all. §5b.4: Projects modal — list with per-project tier chips (emerald local llm_*, violet fix override or 'global default'), create/edit form with tier-colored fieldsets, empty fix fields PATCH explicit nulls to clear the override per §5.3 semantics, per-project Clone repo → POST /projects/{id}/clone; New report modal → POST /reports with warnings surfaced in toast; Retry button renders only when failed_stage is set; analysis_mode selector gained an explanatory tooltip. Live-smoked via Playwright: report created end-to-end from the form and appeared on the board, search/attn filters + clear verified, terminal collapse/expand toggled, retry visibility confirmed on failed vs healthy reports, project edit form renders both tier fieldsets. Only console entry is the expected 404 from the localization probe on never-localized reports (caught in code). This completes the full Phase 5b plan scope (Cycles 1+2). CLAUDE.md status refreshed.

Approved. Reviewed commit 0edabe5 for Phase 5b Cycle 2. The implementation is contained to the dashboard static assets and status docs, matches the approved 5b.3/5b.4 scope, and does not change backend API contracts. Health LEDs use public /health without making degraded components a poll failure; filters, terminal collapse, project management, new-report submission, clone action, retry-only-when-failed, and analysis_mode tooltip are wired against existing endpoints. Verification: node --check src/bugalizer/static/app.js passed; uv run pytest -q -> 201 passed.
